title: The Video Call Officer
intro: Your phone rings with a video call from someone in a police-style uniform. He says you are in serious trouble.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

video.label: They called you, on video
video.lens: An officer you have never met calls you on video, out of the blue.
video.why: Official cases are not handled by a surprise video call.

parcel.label: "A parcel in your name"
parcel.lens: A parcel you never sent, full of illegal items.
parcel.why: A parcel story is a common script.

digital.label: "Digital arrest"
digital.lens: You are told you are arrested, but only through a screen.
digital.why: This is the scam the government warns about. Ending the call is always allowed.

stay.label: "Stay on camera"
stay.lens: They keep you on the call so you cannot check with anyone.
stay.why: Keeping you on camera is how victims are controlled.

tell.label: "Tell no one"
tell.lens: You are told to keep it secret from your family.
tell.why: Secrecy stops people helping you. Always tell someone.

safe.label: "Move your money to a safe account"
safe.lens: They want your savings moved to an account they give you.
safe.why: No honest officer asks you to move money anywhere.

name.label: A strong title and name
name.lens: Inspector Kale of the Cyber Crime Branch.
name.why: A title is easy to say. It proves nothing.

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A number you do not know.

badge.label: A badge picture
badge.why: Badges and uniforms are easy to fake.

actions.label: Do as the officer says and move the money
End the call, then tell my family and call the helpline
End the call and report it on 1930

block_report.line: You ended the call and reported it on the cyber helpline. The number was traced and blocked.

verify.line: You ended the call and rang your family. They knew at once it was a scam and helped you report it. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: Your savings moved to a stranger's account while you sat in front of the camera. The "officer" vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: Ending the call and telling someone was always allowed. A real case is never closed by moving money.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: No one can arrest you through a screen. End the call, tell someone you trust, and report on the cyber helpline (1930 in India).

quick_check.q: A video call says you are under "digital arrest" and must stay on camera, tell no one and move your savings. What do you do?

options.text: Obey but ask for a letter
End the call, tell your family and report it on the cyber helpline

quick_check.explain: Panic is the weapon. Ending the call and telling someone breaks the spell.

hints.nudge: Why would an officer tell you to keep a case secret?

rows.k: Asked you to stay on camera
Asked you to tell no one
Criminals pose as police and other agencies
rows.v: They claim a parcel or a relative, then demand money
